posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal welcomed their first baby, son Vihaan Kaushal, with fans showering love as new family photos go viral on social media.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit surprised Toronto fans by unveiling the 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' trailer during his AURA Tour 2026 concert, while Badshah joined him for a surprise duet in London.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia kicks off promotions for YRF's 'Alpha' with Sharvari Wagh ahead of its July 3 release — the first female-led film in the YRF Spy Universe.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu, with an Antarctica schedule planned.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's 'King' is reconfirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a massive ₹350-400 crore budget — filming recently wrapped a song with Deepika in Cape Town.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena congratulates Rani Mukerji on completing 30 years in Bollywood, while fans eagerly await her 2026 comeback alongside the industry's biggest stars.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha shocked netizens with her glowing review of Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar', fueling buzz around her upcoming projects in 2026.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announces she's expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh while juggling 'King' with SRK and Atlee's 'Raka' with Allu Arjun using a body double for action scenes.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's 'Dhurandhar 2' crossed ₹1,800 crore worldwide, becoming the highest-grossing Indian film ever. His next, post-apocalyptic thriller 'Pralay', begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya named Global Brand Ambassador for JW Marriott, while her stunning Cannes 2026 look with daughter Aaradhya in a blush pink couture gown went viral.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika reunites with Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi epic 'Raka' as the main villain — a bold departure from her Pushpa franchise role, with look tests already done in LA.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's debut production 'Maa Inti Bangaram' trailer drops — she plays a fierce housewife with a hidden past in this action-family drama releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's sci-fi spectacle 'Raka' with director Atlee is shaping up as the biggest Indian film ever, featuring Deepika, Rashmika, and multiple roles for the Pushpa star.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports action drama 'Peddi' with Janhvi Kapoor releases today, June 4 — early reviews call it a mass entertainer with powerful action sequences.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR set to reunite with director Trivikram for a mythological epic about God of War Kartikeya, after Allu Arjun amicably exits the project over scheduling conflicts.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi's 'Peddi' opposite Ram Charan hits theaters today. She also stars in Allu Arjun and Atlee's mega-budget sci-fi 'Raka' — a packed 2026 lineup.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya turned heads in a stunning all-white ethnic look at a Mumbai event, while her Netflix hit 'Call Me Bae' continues to build her brand as a Gen-Z style icon.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara dazzled at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary in a pink saree, while fans await her fierce avatar as Nadia in Yash's 'Toxic'.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik begins pre-production on 'Krrish 4' — his directorial debut — with Priyanka Chopra confirmed as female lead. Shooting starts summer 2026 for a 2027 release.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' releases tomorrow June 5 — his fourth collaboration with dad David Dhawan, billed as the first major post-IPL release.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announces 'The Unstoppable Tour' — a massive Australia + North America concert tour spanning Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, and 10 US/Canada cities from June to September 2026.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's 'Ishq Mastana' from 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Diljit drops to critical acclaim. His Rangreza concert played Toronto, with a US show at Wolf Trap in July.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film 'Jananayagan' eyes a massive release window as KVN Productions juggles it alongside Yash's 'Toxic' — both mega-budget spectacles exceeding ₹500 crore.
